title: Compliance Operations Calendar: Information Request and Periodic Review Terms for the Personal Sender Account
content:
Paloma Compliance runs two recurring calendars on every Personal Sender Account: the answer window and reminders of a request for information, and the periodic identity (KYC) review of the level held. Their figures are set per verification level.

## Requests for information

| Level | Answer window after the request is issued (calendar days) | Interval between automatic reminders while the request is open (calendar days) | Rejected document submissions against one open request that trigger suspension |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 14 | 5 | 2 |
| Paloma Verified | 14 | 5 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 14 | 5 | 3 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 21 | 7 | 3 |
| Paloma Premier | 30 | 7 | 4 |
| Paloma Private Client | 30 | 10 | 4 |

## Periodic KYC review

| Level | Calendar months between mandatory KYC refresh reviews | Grace after a periodic review falls due, before the account is restricted for the refresh (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 0 | 0 |
| Paloma Verified | 36 | 30 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 36 | 30 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 24 | 30 |
| Paloma Premier | 12 | 45 |
| Paloma Private Client | 12 | 60 |

An interval of 0 months means the level has no periodic review.

## Points of reading

- Paloma Starter is the only level without a periodic review; Paloma Verified and Paloma Verified Plus share a 36-month interval, Paloma Enhanced runs on 24 months, and the two highest levels on 12 months.
- The answer window lengthens with the level, from 14 calendar days at the three lower levels to 30 at Paloma Premier and Paloma Private Client.
- Hypothetical reading: at Paloma Enhanced a request for information issued on a given day has an answer window of 21 calendar days, reminders every 7 calendar days while it is open, and suspension follows the third rejected submission against it.
